story_text: As a staff member, I want to delete a pending booking so that cancelled or invalid bookings are removed.

positive.title: Delete a pending booking with a valid ID as staff
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the pending booking
3. Click submit

positive.title: Delete a cancelled booking with a valid ID as staff
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the cancelled booking
3. Click submit

positive.title: Delete an invalid booking booking with a valid ID as staff
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the invalid booking
3. Click submit

positive.title: Validate that Deleted booking is no longer retrievable by ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the pending booking
3. Click submit
4. Navigate to get specific booking endpoint
5. click submit
positive.expected_result: Booking is deleted successfully and is no longer retrievable

negative.title: Delete a booking as a guest (unauthorized)
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint as a guest
2. Add the ID of the pending booking
3. Click submit

negative.title: Delete a booking with a non-existent ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the non-existent booking
3. Click submit
negative.expected_result: A prompt error stating tht the ID is incorrect

negative.title: Delete a booking with an invalid ID format
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the invalid ID format of the pending booking
3. Click submit
negative.expected_result: A prompt error stating tht the ID is incorrect

negative.title: Delete a confirmed booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the confirmed booking
3. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error stating that confirmed bookings can't be deleted

edge.title: Delete a booking whose check-in date is today
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the booking whose check-in is today
3. Click submit

edge.title: Delete an already deleted booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the delete booking endpoint
2. Add the ID of the pending booking
3. Click submit
4. Add the ID of the deleted booking again
5. Click submit
edge.expected_result: A prompt error stating tht the ID is incorrect
